transformation.command: nif-port-cli.exe clone-shape "<mods>/<body refit mod>/meshes/clothes/fineclothes01/<name>.nif" "<mods>/Better Fur - Fine Clothes/meshes/clothes/fineclothes01/<name>.nif" <shape-name> "<output>/meshes/clothes/fineclothes01/<name>.nif"  (one invocation per mesh; per-mesh commands below)
